definitions.explanation: The horizontal measurement of something from side to side.
The extent or variety of something; room for variation.

examples.english: This road is narrow (has little width).

examples.japanese: ⟦{幅|はば}{広|ひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: They have a wide range of knowledge.
examples.notes: ⟦{幅|はば}{広|ひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧ = wide-ranging

examples.english: The width of this shelf is 90 centimeters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幅|はば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}くて→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{泳|およ}いで→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{渡|わた}れない→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: The river is too wide to swim across.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幅|はば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: Broaden the scope of your knowledge through reading.
examples.notes: {幅|はば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ = to broaden, to expand

notes:
USAGE: {幅|はば} refers to physical width and figurative breadth/range.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {幅|はば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧／⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ (wide/narrow)
- {幅|はば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to broaden)
- ⟦{幅|はば}{広|ひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧ (broadly, widely)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幅|はば} (the width of ~, the range of ~)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{幅|はば}{広|ひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧ (wide, broad)
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{幅|はば}→振り幅：28207_furihaba⟧ (range of movement, swing width)
- ⟦{値|ね}{幅|はば}→値幅：28208_nehaba⟧ (price range)
- ⟦{上|あ}げ{幅|はば}→上げ幅：28280_agehaba⟧ (margin of increase/decrease)

DIMENSIONS:
- {幅|はば} - width
- ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧ - length
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ - height
- ⟦{深|ふか}さ→深さ：05328_fukasa⟧ - depth
